title: runtime error after streamed output
notes: Under the default `--stream result` the program's output is written without a trailing newline, so the diagnostic used to start in the middle of it: `partial output hereprog.pdl:3:5 - ...`. `ensure_line_start` terminates the line before any diagnostic is printed; the harness captures the two streams separately, so what this pins is the newline at the end of stdout.
